Hi Tomasz — thanks for the quick context and the PO. This is the right set of details to start. High-level: in most cases where a EU B2B customer supplies a valid VAT ID, we invoice without local VAT and the recipient accounts for VAT (reverse-charge). That said, the precise billing entity we use (Redwood, Inc. US vs Redwood EU Ltd) determines the invoice legal entity and whether any VAT/GST is applied for place-of-supply reasons.

Next steps from our side (short):
- Im attaching our VAT mapping matrix (redwood_vat-mapping-matrix.xlsx) with the common permutations and the documentation we typically ask for.
- Please attach your official VAT registration extract (PDF) and a contact for someone who can sign a simple self-billing acknowledgment if you prefer Redwood to self-bill.
- Confirm which legal entity on your PO you intend to pay (FinBridge Poland → pay to Redwood EU Ltd, or FinBridge Poland → pay to Redwood, Inc.).

For our finance/tax team well need:
- VAT registration extract (country + VAT number)
- Name of the paying legal entity and invoicing address to match your bank routing
- PO number (you included 45731 — perfect)

Ill loop in our tax lead (Markus) for any nuance on the mapping. If reverse-charge applies, we will reissue the invoice net and include the reverse-charge reference on the invoice. If not, well include VAT and flag it to your AP team.

Best,
Jordan Blake

Jordan / Tomasz — quick tax follow-up from our side. Based on the info provided (FinBridge PL VAT ID), reverse-charge is likely and appropriate for software services supplied B2B. A few items we need to be certain about before reissuing: 

Checklist (what we need from FinBridge):
- Confirm the VAT registration country (Poland) and provide the VAT certificate (official extract or EU VIES screenshot).
- Confirm paying entity name exactly as it appears on the VAT certificate.
- Confirm invoicing address and the bank entity that will make payment (helps with cross-border reporting).
- Clarify if FinBridge requests Redwood to act under a self-billing arrangement (if yes, well send a short form).

Invoice fields we will include when issuing a reverse-charge invoice: 
- Supplier legal name and VAT (Redwood EU Ltd, VAT: GB987654321 — sample)
- Customer legal name and VAT (FinBridge Analytics, PL1234567890)
- PO reference: 45731
- Line-level description of services, currency, net amounts, and a note: "VAT Reverse-Charge — Article XYZ / Customer liable for VAT"

If FinBridge prefers to keep the US entity as the billing party, we need to confirm whether local VAT is expected — that often introduces taxable supply in the customers jurisdiction and may require us to register.

Happy to take the self-billing form offline and provide a signed copy. If you attach your VAT extract we can make progress.

-Markus
